Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a reticulo-nodular pattern predominantly in the right perihilar region and left mid-zone (indicated by blue arrows), along with nodular opacities in the left upper zone and adjacent to the left costo-phrenic angle (indicated by the yellow circle). This bilateral, multifocal distribution involving the perihilar regions and lung bases is consistent with the typical radiographic presentation of pulmonary sarcoidosis.
